scope: GBP Labour PIT + AWE + CPI Services -> BoE domestic-pressure state -> observed 5-market-day 2Y OIS repricing -> GBP G8 basket. Wages+services define primary domestic inflation pressure; Labour is context.

architecture.labour: frozen-style median of employment (+) and unemployment (-) normalized impulses
architecture.services: CPI Services D7NN YoY frozen-style impulse
architecture.boe_primary_direction: wages and services when aligned; no fitted weights
architecture.rates: 2Y OIS observed state only, never a gate
